transcript: The difference between me and most entrepreneurs, I didn't have a specific passion or enthusiasm other than I wanted to run and scale a business. And then the most complicated part is growing revenues. But your risk profile generally will keep you from maybe realizing any of it. And if you're not risk averse enough, it's really easy to go out of business. So good risk assessment and then good judgment sooner or later, hopefully that will converge to where you, whatever you're doing crosses the five year threshold, which 80% are generally not there. And then I think 90% don't make it to maybe 10 years. Once you hit 10 years, most businesses end plow forward.
